summary: A docs folder whose remote refuses every push, as a protected branch does
description: A branch off main with one commit, pushed and checked out, on a remote that answers any further push with GitHub's own protected-branch wording from a hook the bare really runs. origin answers get-url with a GitHub address, so the app can offer a pull request, which is the way into a protected branch. The hook is installed last, so building the history still pushes.
